canonical_candidate_id.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false

edge_case_rules.backport_or_cherry_pick: Different repair SHA or different pre-repair snapshot means a distinct candidate; retain a POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE relation only when exact non-semantic patch evidence supports it.
edge_case_rules.branch_specific_fix: The pre-repair snapshot is identity-bearing; equal repair endpoints with different snapshots remain distinct candidates.
edge_case_rules.equivalent_patch_different_sha: Never auto-collapse; preserve both candidates. An exact deterministic patch digest may create POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE provenance but is not canonical identity.
edge_case_rules.multi_fix_commit: One repository/snapshot/repair range remains one candidate episode; semantic narrowness is not decided during discovery.
edge_case_rules.one_commit_multiple_issues: Retain every issue, advisory, benchmark, and query source record as provenance for one exact repair-range candidate; no source-task lead is discarded.

candidate_identity_override.reason_for_change: Repository ID plus repair SHA can name more than one repair range when sources or branches supply different valid pre-repair snapshots.

candidate_provenance_index.content: sorted unique source_record_id values plus every source-native identity and raw-artifact hash
candidate_provenance_index.generation: derive only after all source records are finalized; bytewise sort candidate IDs and source-record IDs
candidate_provenance_index.immutability: append-only across later source additions; never delete or rewrite an earlier source record

cross_source_provenance_override.materialization_manifest: After capture, write a separate canonical manifest binding the raw capture-manifest SHA-256, every encountered source-object ID, every MATERIALIZED or SOURCE_REJECTED source-record ID, candidate links, and the provenance-index SHA-256. Require exact one-to-one source-object accounting before ledger projection.
cross_source_provenance_override.exact_duplicate: Repository ID, pre-repair snapshot, and repair endpoint must all be equal. Same repository ID and PR number is exact only when those two SHAs also agree.
cross_source_provenance_override.missing_metadata: Absent, null, empty, unresolved, or inaccessible fields never imply equality and never substitute for a canonical identity field.
cross_source_provenance_override.pr_commit_cross_source_match: A PR-linked repair and an explicit commit repair collapse only when repository ID, pre-repair snapshot, and repair SHA are all exactly equal.
cross_source_provenance_override.source_priority: Affects provenance display order only; never identity, inclusion, score, rejection, or scientific rank.

failure_semantics.atomicity: Capture and normalization are separate transactions. Any batch-level failure finalizes CAPTURE_FAILED, preserves all raw attempts, and materializes zero candidates from that source execution.

cases.deleted_or_inaccessible_repository: After the bounded redirect rule, HTTP 404/410 or absent repository ID => SOURCE_REJECTED:GITHUB_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE for the encountered source object.
cases.malformed_metadata: Use the inherited exact BUGSINPY_* or ADVISORY_MALFORMED per-record disposition; preserve raw bytes first.
cases.missing_issue_or_pr: HTTP 404/410 or null required GraphQL node => SOURCE_REJECTED:GITHUB_ISSUE_OR_PR_UNAVAILABLE.
cases.rate_limit_exhaustion: HTTP 403/429 with rate-limit evidence => batch-level API_RATE_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED; do not retry in the same execution.
cases.repository_rename_or_transfer: Follow at most one recorded redirect, then require the final positive repository numeric ID to equal the ID captured in the search or source-resolution object. New owner/name/URL are capture metadata and do not change identity; conflicting IDs fail with GITHUB_REPOSITORY_IDENTITY_CHANGED.
cases.source_schema_drift: Missing or type-changed search envelope fields fail the entire query; missing detail fields reject that source record. Use SOURCE_SCHEMA_DRIFT and never infer a replacement field.
cases.transient_api_failure: Apply the bounded request policy. Exhaustion is batch-level API_TRANSIENT_FAILURE_EXHAUSTED with no partial materialization.

reason_codes_added.API_RATE_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED: A 403/429 response carries primary or secondary rate-limit evidence.
reason_codes_added.API_REDIRECT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: More than one redirect is required for a logical request.
reason_codes_added.API_TRANSIENT_FAILURE_EXHAUSTED: All three deterministic attempts failed transiently.
reason_codes_added.BENCHMARK_REPAIR_ANCESTRY_INVALID: The declared buggy snapshot is not an ancestor of the declared fixed endpoint.
reason_codes_added.GITHUB_COMMIT_UNAVAILABLE: An exact required commit cannot be retrieved and verified.
reason_codes_added.GITHUB_ISSUE_OR_PR_UNAVAILABLE: A required issue or pull request cannot be retrieved.
reason_codes_added.GITHUB_PR_ENDPOINT_PARENT_MISMATCH: A two-parent endpoint does not have the captured PR head as its second parent.
reason_codes_added.GITHUB_PR_MERGE_TOPOLOGY_AMBIGUOUS: A merged PR has zero, more than two, or multi-commit single-parent endpoint topology.
reason_codes_added.GITHUB_REPOSITORY_IDENTITY_CHANGED: A redirect resolves to a conflicting repository numeric ID.
reason_codes_added.GITHUB_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE: A required repository is deleted or inaccessible.
reason_codes_added.GITHUB_SEARCH_ATOMIC_PARTITION_OVERFLOW: A one-second created-at partition still exceeds 1,000 results.
reason_codes_added.GITHUB_SEARCH_PARTITION_COUNT_MISMATCH: A parent count does not equal its two disjoint child counts, or encountered parent items are absent from leaf captures.
reason_codes_added.RAW_ARTIFACT_HASH_MISMATCH: Stored raw bytes do not match their declared SHA-256.
reason_codes_added.RAW_CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE: A capture manifest is not durably finalized as CAPTURE_COMPLETE.
reason_codes_added.SOURCE_SCHEMA_DRIFT: A source or API object differs from the frozen structural schema.

before_execution: commit this amendment and its tests
record the final project commit and hashes of v0.2 plus v0.3 files
validate the eight unchanged root query templates statically
verify authentication exists without making a source request
create a new empty no-overwrite capture destination
execution_must_not_begin_if: any v0.3 file hash differs from the execution freeze
the capture destination already contains a manifest
authentication or durable storage preflight fails

github_created_partition_override.atomic_overflow: If start_utc equals end_utc and total_count is greater than 1,000, fail the entire eight-query source execution with GITHUB_SEARCH_ATOMIC_PARTITION_OVERFLOW. Do not add a semantic or identity-derived partition.
count_reconciliation: For every split node require parent.total_count = left.total_count + right.total_count.
For every leaf require the union of page item node_id values to have cardinality exactly leaf.total_count; repeated or missing items fail closed.
Require every node_id encountered on a parent probe to occur in exactly one completed leaf capture or the deterministic rejected-object set.
Require node_id sets from disjoint leaves to be disjoint before query-level deduplication.
Any violation fails the entire source execution with GITHUB_SEARCH_PARTITION_COUNT_MISMATCH.
github_created_partition_override.leaf_capture: When total_count is at most 1,000 and incomplete_results is false, retain the probe as page 1 and fetch exactly pages 2..ceil(total_count/100), with page 1 only for a zero-result leaf.
github_created_partition_override.partition_order: deterministic depth-first traversal, left child before right child
github_created_partition_override.query_construction: Replace the root template's single created qualifier with exactly created:{start_utc}..{end_utc}; change no other token or request parameter.
github_created_partition_override.recursion: If total_count exceeds 1,000 and start_utc is before end_utc, compute midpoint=floor((start_epoch_seconds+end_epoch_seconds)/2); recurse on inclusive [start,midpoint], then inclusive [midpoint+1 second,end].
github_created_partition_override.scientific_independence: Partition only on frozen creation time and deterministic counts; never inspect titles, repositories, apparent quality, security relevance, or any candidate feature to choose a boundary.
github_created_partition_override.source_transaction: All eight root queries form one capture transaction. Any query-level failure prevents normalization for all eight while preserving raw attempts.

raw_capture_override.manifest_write: After every referenced artifact is durably written, write canonical JSON to a new temporary file, fsync, atomically rename to capture-manifest.json with no overwrite, then write capture-manifest.json.sha256. The raw manifest records encountered source objects with disposition_phase=NOT_STARTED; dispositions belong only to the later materialization manifest.
raw_capture_override.normalization_gate: Normalization reads only a CAPTURE_COMPLETE manifest and re-hashes every artifact. CAPTURE_FAILED and any hash/path mismatch materialize zero candidates.
raw_capture_override.source_record_revision_mapping: For pinned Git sources use the exact source commit. For API sources use the finalized capture-manifest sidecar SHA-256 as VERSIONED_API_CAPTURE; the query-specification hash remains inside the raw manifest and avoids self-reference.
raw_capture_override.pinned_git_sources: Store exact source blobs, pinned tree-entry metadata, and any later resolution response in the same content-addressed layout before parsing.
raw_capture_override.raw_write: Hash exact bytes first; create the content-addressed path without overwrite; if it exists, verify identical bytes; fsync file and parent directory before referencing it.
raw_capture_override.retention: Raw bytes, all attempts, failed captures, manifests, and sidecar hashes are append-only and are never normalized in place.
raw_capture_override.sensitive_headers: Never store Authorization, cookies, token-bearing URLs, or credential material.

advisory_explicit_commit.validation: Require the commit to resolve in the canonical repository and have exactly one parent; zero or multiple parents remain SOURCE_REJECTED:ADVISORY_COMMIT_PARENT_NOT_SINGLE.

repair_anchor_override.advisory_pull_request: Apply the merged-PR topology rule; explicit PR and commit references collapse only under the v0.3 three-field exact identity.
repair_anchor_override.ambiguous_advisory_references: Materialize each independently resolvable explicit reference. Never infer an anchor from prose, issue text, release notes, branch names, or neighboring references. Reject unresolved accepted references per record.

benchmark_metadata.validation: Capture both commit objects and trees and a deterministic ancestry proof that buggy_commit_id is an ancestor of fixed_commit_id; otherwise SOURCE_REJECTED:BENCHMARK_REPAIR_ANCESTRY_INVALID.

repair_anchor_override.issue_lead: An issue remains a lead only. Materialize every deterministically linked merged PR under the merged-PR topology rule. A direct issue-linked commit without a qualifying merged PR is not a candidate anchor and is SOURCE_REJECTED:GITHUB_ISSUE_LEAD_NO_MERGED_PR.

merged_pull_request.base_sha_role: Capture PR base.sha as API metadata but do not use it alone as the pre-repair snapshot.
merged_pull_request.branch_deletion: Branch names and continued branch existence are not required after exact head, endpoint, parent, and tree objects resolve.
capture: PR number, base.sha, head.sha, and merge_commit_sha
complete paginated PR commit list and declared commit count
repair endpoint commit object, tree, and ordered parent SHAs
pre-repair snapshot commit object and tree
merged_pull_request.ordinary_merge: If the endpoint has exactly two parents, require parent[1] equals captured head.sha; candidate snapshot is parent[0], repair endpoint is merge_commit_sha. This supports one- or multi-commit ordinary merges.
merged_pull_request.single_commit_single_parent: If the endpoint has exactly one parent and the complete PR commit count is exactly one, candidate snapshot is that parent and repair endpoint is merge_commit_sha; squash versus rebase does not alter the range.
merged_pull_request.single_parent_multi_commit: If the endpoint has exactly one parent and PR commit count is greater than one, squash and rebase imply different pre-repair ranges but GitHub PR detail does not provide immutable merge-method evidence. Fail closed with GITHUB_PR_MERGE_TOPOLOGY_AMBIGUOUS.
merged_pull_request.unsupported_topology: Zero parents, more than two parents, missing endpoint objects, or two-parent head mismatch fail closed; never guess from commit messages or branch names.

repair_anchor_override.repair_range: The exact candidate repository state transition is candidate_snapshot_commit_sha..repair_commit_sha; both endpoint trees and all required ancestry/topology evidence are immutable capture artifacts.

request_policy_override.rate_limit: Do not retry 403 or 429 in the same source execution. Record Retry-After and all available X-RateLimit fields, finalize CAPTURE_FAILED, and use API_RATE_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED.
record_for_every_logical_request: API version and Accept media type
attempt start and end UTC timestamps
connect, read, and total timeout values
HTTP status or frozen transport-error code
non-sensitive response headers including Date, Retry-After, ETag, X-GitHub-Api-Version-Selected, X-GitHub-Request-Id, and all available X-RateLimit fields
exact raw-response SHA-256 and content-addressed path when a body exists
request_policy_override.redirects: Follow at most one 301, 302, 307, or 308 response for detail endpoints; preserve both responses and Location. Search and GraphQL endpoints must not redirect. A second redirect fails with API_REDIRECT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

scientific_separation_override.query_family_basis: Frozen query-design provenance only; never copy it into a candidate trust-family field.
scientific_separation_override.ranking: No ML model, language model, heuristic score, manual attractiveness judgment, or treatment/experiment signal may rank, omit, substitute, split, or prioritize discovered source objects.
